scope: Existing original sources only; no new art, database or server changes
limits: Ruffle renders the unmodified decoded asset timelines, including independently looping children. It is an emulator, not an Adobe Flash visual acceptance oracle.

If Ruffle is unavailable or its active-player limit is reached, lossless WebP falls back to the rendered root cycle; independently looping children can reset at the root boundary. Three one-frame roots use a still fallback.
Existing source heads only; absent native files are not replaced with invented or unrelated artwork.

lifecyclePatch.scope: Four Ruffle-owned resume promise callsites only; closed-context cancellation, all other errors preserved

loadLifecyclePatch.name: m84-load-disconnect-cancellation-v1
loadLifecyclePatch.scope: One Ruffle async-load lifecycle; a cancelled load cannot overwrite or destroy a newer instance.
